current_known_boundary.method: Australian Space Agency Maximum Probable Loss Methodology (2019)
current_known_boundary.screening_geometry: ROMER_SCREENING_HEURISTIC where current HVA heuristic is used

rule: MPL is admitted only for the bounded financial/insurance consequence question for which it is applicable. It may inform, but never replace, risk-hazard analysis or engineering safety assurance.

corpus_test_binding.input_rule: compile applicable launch/site/vehicle/method parameters from admitted corpus records and final dependency receipts; unresolved inputs HOLD
corpus_test_binding.result_rule: MPL outputs are unknown until the model executes and remain bounded screening outputs
corpus_test_binding.downstream_rule: only proven + verified-readback + committed receipts may parameterise dependent sweeps
